title: Checkout page
summary: Checkout page composed from the marketing header + commerce-checkout (form + order summary) + marketing footer.
brief: Build the checkout page: marketing-header for site nav, commerce-checkout as the body (form on the left, order summary on the right), and marketing-footer. Form submission and payment processing live with the consumer.
layout: Stack sections vertically. The body section (commerce-checkout) carries its own two-column layout (form left + summary right on ≥lg). Each section installs as its own file — import a block from `@/components/ui/<section.block>` (e.g. `import { CommerceCheckout } from "@/components/ui/commerce-checkout"`).

checklist.check: [MarketingHeader] Avoid: Passing more than ~5 links — the inline row gets crowded; group secondary items under the CTA or a footer.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , losing button styling.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Forgetting the logo links to '/' — wrap the logo node in an anchor.

[MarketingHeader] A11y: The mobile toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at the panel and an aria-label that flips between 'Open menu' / 'Close menu'. Links are real anchors, keyboard-focusable, with visible focus rings.
[CommerceCheckout] Avoid: Inputs without <Label htmlFor> — the block lays out the form but doesn't wire labels for you.
[CommerceCheckout] Avoid: Putting the submit button only in the summary — keep the primary 'Pay' action in the form's flow.
[CommerceCheckout] Avoid: Omitting fieldset/legend grouping for contact vs shipping vs payment, hurting form comprehension.

[CommerceCheckout] A11y: The summary column is an <aside> labelled 'Order summary'. The optional title is the page <h1>. Accessible names depend on the Label/control pairing and fieldset/legend grouping in the form you supply.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: One column with 20 links instead of a few grouped columns — group by topic.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Omitting the copyright line, which most footers are expected to carry.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Putting social icons with no accessible label — wrap each in a link with an aria-label or sr-only text.

[MarketingFooter] A11y: Each column title renders as an <h3>. Links are real anchors with visible hover/focus states. Social icon links need an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text) since the icon alone isn't announced.
